Constraint / Qualifier: Metastatic/locally advanced; HER2-, ER-, PR-; histologically documented
No prior systemic therapy for inoperable locally advanced/metastatic TNBC
Example EMR Text: No prior systemic therapy for TNBC

Constraint / Qualifier: Eligible for taxane monotherapy (no life-threatening visceral metastases, no rapid progression)
Representative FFPE block or atleast 20 unstained slides (atleast 12 if approved)
Example EMR Text: Submitted FFPE tissue for ER/PR/HER2 testing

Constraint / Qualifier: Known CNS disease except treated asymptomatic metastases
Prior allogeneic stem cell or solid organ transplant
Received live, attenuated vaccine within 4 weeks pre-randomization, during treatment, or atleast 5 months after last dose
Example EMR Text: Received live flu vaccine 3 weeks before randomization
